        c.Segment,
        ym.Date,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption

    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN '2012-01' AND '2013-12'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.Date
),
yearly AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        CAST(SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
